items.reason: Title and conditions use "Glioblastoma Multiforme"; IDH-wildtype status is not required - only patients "Known to have an IDH mutation prior to enrollment" are excluded, so untested patients can enter. C8 needs the record to require IDH-wildtype status or cite WHO 2021 for cns5.

note: If XL reads exclusion of known IDH-mutant tumours as an IDH-wildtype requirement, both cns5 and historical criteria are met and C8 would give cns5.
